text: The hand of the LORD was on me, and he brought me out by his Spirit and set me down in the middle of a valley; it was full of bones.
He led me back and forth among them, and I saw a great many bones scattered on the valley floor, bones that were very dry.
He asked me, "Son of man, can these bones live?" I answered, "Lord GOD, you alone know."
Then he said to me, "Prophesy over these bones and tell them, 'Dry bones, hear the word of the LORD!'
This is what the Lord GOD says to these bones: I am about to make breath enter you, and you will live.
I will attach sinews to you, bring flesh up on you, cover you with skin, and put breath in you so that you come to life. Then you will know that I am the LORD."
So I prophesied as I was commanded. As I did, there was a noise — a rattling sound — and the bones came together, bone to its bone.
I looked, and sinews and flesh appeared on them and skin covered them, but there was no breath in them.
Then he told me, "Prophesy to the breath. Prophesy, son of man, and say to it: This is what the Lord GOD says: Come, breath, from the four winds and breathe into these slain, so that they may live."
So I prophesied as he commanded me, and breath entered them; they came to life and stood on their feet, an army so vast it could not be numbered.
Then he said to me, "Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel. Look, they keep saying, 'Our bones are dried up, our hope has perished; we are cut off.'
Therefore prophesy and tell them: This is what the Lord GOD says: My people, I am going to open your graves and bring you up out of them; I will bring you back to the land of Israel.
You will know that I am the LORD, my people, when I open your graves and bring you up from them.
I will put my Spirit in you and you will live, and I will settle you in your own land. Then you will know that I, the LORD, have spoken it, and I have done it — this is the LORD's declaration."
The word of the LORD came to me again:

"Son of man, take one piece of wood and write on it, 'Belonging to Judah and the Israelites associated with him.' Then take another piece of wood and write on it, 'Belonging to Joseph — the stick of Ephraim — and all the house of Israel associated with him.'
Join the two pieces together into a single stick so that they become one in your hand.
When your people ask you, 'Won't you tell us what you mean by this?' —

tell them: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to take the stick of Joseph, which is in Ephraim's hand, and join it to Judah's stick. I will make them into a single stick, and they will become one in my hand.
Hold the sticks you have written on where your people can see them,
and say to them: This is what the Lord GOD says: I am going to take the Israelites out of the nations where they have gone. I will gather them from every side and bring them into their own land.
I will make them one nation in the land, on the mountains of Israel, and there will be a single king over all of them. Never again will they be two nations or split into two kingdoms.

They will no longer defile themselves with their idols, their vile images, or any of their transgressions. I will save them from all their unfaithfulness by which they sinned, and I will cleanse them. They will be my people, and I will be their God.
"My servant David will be king over them, and there will be one shepherd for all of them. They will follow my ordinances, keep my statutes, and carry them out.

They will live in the land I gave to my servant Jacob, the land where their ancestors lived. They will live in it forever with their children and grandchildren, and my servant David will be their prince forever.
I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be a permanent covenant with them. I will establish and multiply them, and I will set my sanctuary among them forever.
My dwelling place will be with them, and I will be their God, and they will be my people.
Then, when my sanctuary is among them forever, the nations will know that I am the LORD, the one who sets Israel apart as holy."
